name: orbit.agent

baseline.mcpToolsListBytesNote: initialize + tools/list stdout; the initialize response is 144 bytes
baseline.cliCapabilitiesBytesNote: the document embeds the caller's context ids, so exact bytes vary by a few dozen

objects.question: What is the whole thing for, and what settles it?
objects.notes: Goal, acceptance criteria, instructions, status, optional coordinator session. Completion is derived from its criteria, requested by the coordinator and recorded by the owner.

objects.question: What is the one piece of work?
objects.notes: One durable work item with exactly one completion criterion. A task may be filed under a project, a list, a parent and prerequisites, but none of those is what it is.

objects.question: How is this class of work dispatched?
objects.notes: Dispatch policy: maxConcurrent, paused (dispatch hold), standing instructions, and the queue task priority orders. It decides when work may run, never what the work is.

objects.question: What is running right now?
objects.notes: One engine conversation on a runner, task-linked or standalone. A session can end; the task outlives it.

objects.question: Where does it run, and under which identity?
objects.notes: Execution identity and location. In the live product this is the workspace row named by MCP agent_* and CLI orbit agent; project-agent-contract.md freezes a future pure-identity split.

routingRules.rule: The smaller object wins: one task beats a project; one task beats a batch of one.
Never double-record: not a task per step of the current task, not a task for the current task, not a session to do what this turn can do.
Read before write when the destination is uncertain: task_list --project-id, project_get, or task_create_batch dryRun.
An engine plan/todo is private scratch; never call it an Orbit record, never claim a task without its id, never refuse to record work because a private plan covers it.

mcp.resultShape: one text content block containing JSON on success or refusal prose; no structuredContent

useFor: work that must outlive the turn
cli.capabilities: orbit capabilities --json (schemaVersion 2; context-dependent). Since 1.1.0 each entry also carries object, intent, risk, approval/approvalKey/approvalDetail, destructive, idempotency, retry, successEvidence, nextStep, returns and availability, and the document carries catalogVersion and catalogHash.
cli.discoveryToday: one ~255 KB document in the fullest context (64 capabilities / ~214 KB with orchestration off, 53 / ~177 KB headless); no graded discovery
cli.jsonOutput: entity document on stdout only; hints on stderr
cli.unknownFlags: refused with exit 1 before any request

parity.note: Since 1.1.0 the operation catalogue (src/runner-go/operation_catalog.go) is the single declaration; these are its current declared gaps, each with a reason in the catalogue row.

createVsStart.dispatches: not in the call; can start later because autoRunWhenReady defaults to true

createVsStart.receipt: task id + status + held for a manual start

createVsStart.note: the runner starts it at once; the once-a-minute scan is the fallback
the person's override; the agent must not undo it

createVsStart.dispatches: when an assignee is bound and all prerequisites are DONE, and for a project task once the project has started; never for a no-project task with no prerequisites

createVsStart.receipt: wouldWrite + per-item landing; explicitly not a write receipt

claudeEngineShellByMode.plan: card per command, Auto classifier off
claudeEngineShellByMode.default: card per command not already allowed
claudeEngineShellByMode.acceptEdits: card per command not already allowed

permission.today: the runner adds no permission-mode gate of its own; the engines differ: Codex plan refuses every MCP call, Codex default/acceptEdits cards every MCP call, Claude's plan policy is unmeasured
permission.target: plan allows Orbit reads and refuses Orbit writes (P1-02)

orchestration.revocation: immediate on session end/reassign or switch off

permission.attribution: in-session writes go to the session's agent and are linked to the session; headless writes fall back to the runner owner

retry.serverInternal: task create runs in one transaction retried on transient database conflict; a redelivered turn dedups on a turn-derived key
retry.createWithoutKey: re-read before retrying; a retry in a later turn does not dedup

errors.unknownFields: contract: refuse before any network write, naming the field; baseline: silently ignored (G1)

receiptRules: Read back when the claim matters.
A receipt is the entity document, not prose about it.
A decline is a refusal, not a success.
Evidence is its own envelope (task_evidence_submit); a comment is not evidence and evidence is not a status write.

scenarios.name: Record a task
scenarios.baselineEvidence: tool + card exist; unknown fields ignored (G1); decline is a non-error result (G4); text-only receipt (G3)

scenarios.name: Private plan
scenarios.baselineEvidence: primer states the rule; no enforcement; plan-mode write gate not implemented (G9)

scenarios.name: Create without start
scenarios.baselineEvidence: the separation exists (startNow/runAt/autoRunWhenReady/card override), but autoRunWhenReady defaults to true and the create tool's top-level description does not lead with it: no-start requires an explicit false (G11)

scenarios.name: Batch plan
scenarios.baselineEvidence: dry-run receipt measured; atomic refs; per-item ids on a real write not measured; decline is a non-error result

scenarios.name: Read-only project inspection
scenarios.baselineEvidence: project_get measured; no project list surface (G6)

scenarios.name: Immediate delegation
scenarios.baselineEvidence: task_start/session_create semantics hold; start receipt split (G3); decline parity gap (G4)

scenarios.name: No orchestration
scenarios.baselineEvidence: 22 tools disappear (measured); no instruction for the absent family (G2/P0-05)

scenarios.name: Compaction recovery
scenarios.baselineEvidence: Codex re-injects after compaction; Claude keeps the system prompt; no MCP instructions; no black-box test (G10)

gaps.gap: unknown MCP fields and wrong types silently ignored
write receipts are unversioned text; start outcome split; no structuredContent
declined card is a non-error MCP result and a non-zero CLI error
task creates take no caller idempotency key
no project list surface on either agent surface
gaps.resolution: recorded as a deliberate absence in the operation catalogue; graded discovery, projects included, belongs to P1-01

gaps.gap: one 255 KB capabilities document; no graded discovery
MCP and CLI surfaces differ by 14 and 3 operations; no single operation catalogue
gaps.resolution: operation_catalog.go declares every operation once; tools/list and capabilities are projections; every deliberate one-surface gap carries a reason; a mandatory test executes every advertised argv/helpArgv

gaps.gap: permission-mode behaviour for Orbit calls is not uniform: no runner gate; Codex plan refuses all MCP calls, Codex default/acceptEdits cards every MCP call, Claude plan policy unmeasured
no black-box evaluation for the eight scenarios
autoRunWhenReady defaults to true and the create tool's top-level description does not lead with it: file-it-for-later can start work once the project starts unless the agent passes false

review.reviewer: independent agent review (fresh context, no part in drafting)
